pages.text: Tier D. 4 iron ingots + 4 Mystery Ingots + a diamond sword. No effect, unbreakable.
Tier C. 4 Mystery Ingots + 4 netherite ingots + Mystery Sword. Sets targets on fire for 10s, stacking.
Tier B. 2 wither skeleton skulls + 4 netherite ingots + 2 nether stars + Spirit Source Sword. Fire and Wither, both stacking.
Tier A. Dragon Soul + 4 end crystals + nether star + dragon head + elytra + Dark Source Sword. Adds Glowing and Weakness III.

Tier S. 4 Heavenly Dao Fragments + 2 nether stars + Origin Dragon Sword. Every effect plus Slowness III; when a hit doesn't kill, spends 100 Mystery Energy to call down thunder: a magic circle appears under the target and 1 second later lightning deals 200 true damage that ignores armor.
